name: agent-output-verifier
title: Agent Output Verifier
description: Independent verification of AI agent output before you pay: check an AI agent's JSON against your JSON Schema and business rules (totals, unique IDs): validate an invoice, check an invoice total, acceptance check of a deliverable, AI agent reputation and trust score. Pass/fail, percentage of checks passed, fix hints, and an Ed25519-signed attestation and receipt. Hosted remote server (Streamable HTTP), free allowance then x402 (USDC) per call: https://verify.sarnai.dev/mcp.
